findings.fact: The optimized internal helper at0x2c69a0 takes five arguments, including a preloaded leading byte in stack slot0x28. The initial four-argument annotation was rejected after the live-in stack reference was inspected; the accepted typed view uses five.

Its four-byte structural branch returns4 and writes the decoded integer; it only sets error8 for an overlong value below0x10000. A structurally complete F4 9C xx xx group decodes above0x10ffff without setting error16.

The outer decoder detects the invalid code point and emits the supplied U+FFFD while retaining status0 and consuming4 bytes. The portable component therefore returns DecodeErrors0 and separately tracks LegacyReplacementGroups; it must not invent a native error16.

scope: Static original decoder value/status contract only; original DLL never executes. Full unrelated legacy UTF8 API behavior, runtime state, document/PC/physical acceptance remain open.
